sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2004
ACT VI OF 2004
SINDH FISHERIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act to amend
the Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-9/2003, dated 11-6-2004.----The
Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Bill, 2003, having been passed by Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 31st, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh-Fisheries (Amendment)
Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance No.III of 1980

ACT VI OF 2004
SINDH FISHERIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act to amend
the Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-9/2003, dated 11-6-2004.----The
Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Bill, 2003, having been passed by Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 31st, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Sindh Ordinance No.III of 1980.- In the Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980,
hereinafter called the said Ordinance, in section 2 after clause (m), the
following new clause shall be inserted;--
"(mm) `net' includes any net
declared as such by Government for the purpose of this Ordinance."

3. Amendment of section 21 of
Sindh Ordinance No.III of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, in section 21, for
subsection (1) the following shall be substituted:
"(1) Whoever contravenes any
provision of section 4 shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may
extend to one year or with a fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees or
with both.
(1-A) Whoever contravenes any
provision of sections 5, 7 or shall be punished with imprisonment which may
extend to six months or with a fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees or
with both "
